messages:
Marco: Heads-up — travel delayed, need to hand off primary early tonight. I’m scheduled until 22:00 PT but can only cover until ~21:30 PT now. Can @Priya pick up primary at 21:30 PT? @Lina will be secondary unless that conflicts. There’s a cluster maintenance window scheduled 21:45-22:15 (non-disruptive per infra), but we should keep an eye on tail latency.

Priya: I can take primary from 21:30 PT. Quick Q — any ongoing alerts or recent flakiness I should watch for?

Marco: No active P1s right now. We had a P2 spike earlier on "text-gen-prod" (elevated 95th latency) around 20:10 but infra mitigated it. Notes: prefix-cache temporarily disabled for ~2h while we tested a config; expect slightly higher token cost/latency.

Lina: I’m secondary for that window. small heads-up: I’ve got ~21:50-22:00 PT I need to step away for 5–10m (personal). If anything spikes then, someone needs to page Aisha as backup.

Aisha: I can be on-call shadow/backup and jump in during Lina’s short break. Add me to the handoff.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance at 2026-03-14T21:45:00-07:00 (PT) — cluster: prod-gpu-pool. No automatic restarts expected.

Marco: Thanks — tagging runbook and quick checklist. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (internal). Handoff checklist (do quickly before swap):
```
- verify no active P1s
- check /alerts for any firing rules containing "text-gen-prod"
- confirm cache-service status: `curl -s https://status.internal/cache | jq .state`
- note recent deploys: canary rolling at 21:40 (see deploy-bot below)
- set "primary" pager to incoming person in OpsPager UI
```

Priya: Got it. I will run the checks at 21:25 PT and then switch primary in OpsPager at 21:28 PT. If anything looks odd, I’ll escalate to Lina/Aisha.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for commit `a8f3b2c` targeting text-gen-prod at 21:40 PT. Watch canary metrics for increased latency or error-rate.

Priya: Noted — I’ll keep an eye on canary from 21:40 and leave the canary dashboard open. Marco, jot anything specific in the handoff note I should inherit?

Marco: Handoff note: recent tokenization change toggled `use_prefix_cache=false` for test cohort -> possible 1.5x token compute. Observed 95th latency up to 480ms earlier. No user-facing errors. No active customer pages. Saved logs: s3://redwood-ops/logs/2026-03-14/latency-spike.log

Lina: Confirmed secondary until 22:30 PT. I’ll monitor silent periods and cover if Priya needs to escalate. Aisha — can you be reachable 21:50-22:05?

Aisha: Yep reachable. Will watch pager. If anything hits P1 during Lina’s 5–10m away, page me immediately and I’ll jump in.

Priya: I just completed checks at 21:25 PT: no active P1s, `cache` service state: "degraded" (expected), recent canary deploy queued. I’m flipping primary in OpsPager at 21:28 PT.

Marco: Thanks — handing off now. Leaving this note in the incident channel and handoff doc. Safe travel y'all. :airplane:

Priya: Primary flipped at 21:28 PT. I’m primary now — taking responsibility. Lina stays secondary, Aisha is backup. All set. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from Marco -> Priya at 1769876928 (ops-audit). Roles: primary=Priya, secondary=Lina, backup=Aisha.

Marco: Confirmed received. If anything measurable (error-rate > 0.5% or 95th latency > 600ms) — immediate page, follow runbook.

Priya: Will do. Logging handoff note in the runbook and closing thread.
